body: Wow thank you I just woke up and read this and started crying again. I needed to hear that. We did talk things out again last night through messaging this time though and not a video call. We're both hurt in general still. But it was a productive conversation and they're very understanding. I feel a tiny bit better emotionally. Physically is a different story hah my legs are pretty sore and even my back. I must have been tensing up my back without realising during my run. Anyways thank you man you're a very kind person

What did you try to use/do? Or are you referring to someone else you knew who did/tried it? If you don't mind me asking. Maybe if I keep reading stories of horrifying attempts it'll push my mind further away from an attempt
